# WashU Resident Advisor knowledge

Unofficial original text extracts, curated summaries, and source pointers. Observed 2026-10-22.

## Entry points

- [README](README.md): task-based navigation
- [Coverage](data/coverage.json): completeness and exclusions
- [Knowledge JSONL](data/knowledge.jsonl): retrieval chunks
- [Links](data/links.json): resource destinations and access notes
- [Documents](data/documents.json): exact titles, extraction status, and content paths
